## @kit/ui/appearance/resolve
export const REDUCED_MOTION: "standard" | "calm" | "reduced"
export type ResolvedAppearance = Readonly<{
    theme: Theme;
    mode: AppearancePreference['mode'];
    accent: AppearancePreference['accent'];
    contrast: Exclude<AppearancePreference['contrast'], 'auto'>;
    sets: SetPerGroup;
}>;
export function resolveAppearance({ theme: themeId, mode, accent, contrast, overrides }: AppearancePreference, { defaults, reducedMotion, prefersMoreContrast, registered, }: Readonly<{ defaults?: TokenSetIds; reducedMotion: boolean; prefersMoreContrast?: boolean; registered?: readonly Theme[]; }>): ResolvedAppearance
